statement: Pinned Linux initialization sends 0x02 device information, 0x10 SPI calibration reads, 0x40 IMU enable, 0x03 mode, and 0x48 vibration enable; player and HOME LEDs use 0x30 and 0x38. SDL requests 0x02, calibration SPI, 0x48, mode and conditionally 0x40 for sensors; it does not require USB-only 0x80 exchanges over Bluetooth. Correctly correlated 0x21 replies are a consumer-facing readiness gate. Other subcommands and exact retail NACK cases are not established.
